description: Under lazy, a closes before B is read, so a B beats A B. In the reconstruction, the KU that a elided is a synthetic token after A. after($x) is the original B, which k does not begin, so the chosen reading survives. A B cannot read the synthetic, so the chosen reading is the only one, and the check passes (engine §7.8).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution lazy elision-only
%elidable KU
%rule text a B | A B
%rule a $x(A) [KU]
%conditions ¬begins(after($x), k)
%rule k KU
